mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at 76 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Verona Community Park and the moon phase is currently a waning crescent.
The Plan Commission is meeting this Tuesday to review development projects, and the City Clerk is moving forward with the winning student designs for the November election stickers.
You have plenty to look forward to including yoga today at Insight Wellness, followed by a packed day tomorrow featuring trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's.
Regarding the weekly report, on Monday July 28 an officer warned two people for being in Fireman Park after hours and arrested the man on an outstanding warrant.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Georgia Peach. The restaurant is open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a refreshing scoop.
